import bsearch


def test_ao01_compositional_hits():
    assert bsearch.bsearch([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 7) == 3
    assert bsearch.bsearch([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 5) == 2
    assert bsearch.bsearch([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 1) == 0

import bsearch


def test_ao01_negative_missing_is_minus_one():
    assert bsearch.bsearch([1, 3, 5], 4) == -1
    assert bsearch.bsearch([1, 3, 5], 0) == -1
    assert bsearch.bsearch([1, 3, 5], 9) == -1
    assert bsearch.bsearch([], 1) == -1

import bsearch


def test_ao01_boundary_single_element():
    assert bsearch.bsearch([42], 42) == 0
    assert bsearch.bsearch([42], 7) == -1
